blocks.text: Freight brokers often keep multiple load boards like Truckstop or DAT open in separate tabs. This can lead to memory issues and slow performance if you have too many extensions running. Use Chrome profiles to keep your work life organized. Create one profile for carrier outreach and another for shipper communication. This prevents your cookies and cached data from mixing between different accounts.
Handling email volume with browser tools

Your inbox is the most important tool you have. If you use Gmail or Outlook on the web, you can use keyboard shortcuts to speed up your process. Press C to compose a new message or R to reply. When you are overwhelmed by emails, ask Lazur to summarize the current thread so you can see the essential load details without reading every single reply.
If a website is acting slow, clear your site data. Go to the address bar, click the lock icon, and select Site settings to manage your permissions and storage for that specific page.
blocks.title: Clear site data

blocks.text: Manual data entry is the biggest drain on your margin. Moving zip codes, weights, and pallet counts from an email to your TMS takes too long. Use Lazur to dictate text directly into your browser fields. Hold the fn key and speak your notes to avoid typing the same information over and over.

items: ⌘ + T: Open a new tab for a new load search.
⌘ + L: Jump to the address bar to switch between your TMS and email.
⌃ + Tab: Switch to the next open tab in your browser.
⌘ + W: Close a tab once you have finished booking a load.
⌘ + Shift + T: Reopen a tab you accidentally closed.

blocks.text: Security is vital when dealing with carrier documents and insurance certificates. Do not save your passwords in your browser if you share a computer. Use a dedicated password manager. Regularly check your extension list to make sure you have not installed any malicious tools that could scrape your load data.

blocks.text: Start by cleaning up your bookmarks. Organize your TMS, load boards, and email into a folder on your bookmarks bar. This saves you from typing URLs every morning. If you struggle with a specific site, ask Lazur to point out the navigation menu or guide you through a complex settings page.

faq.question: Can I use Chrome on Mac for legacy Windows TMS apps?
faq.answer: Chrome cannot run Windows applications directly. You will need a virtualization tool like Parallels or Citrix if your TMS requires a Windows environment.

faq.question: How do I make Chrome faster for logistics work?
faq.answer: Close unused tabs, remove unnecessary extensions, and clear your cache regularly. You can also use separate profiles to keep your browser memory efficient.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside web-based TMS platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can ask it to guide you through a form or dictate data into text fields in your browser.
